name: House Policy Example
description: Structural file/header gates for internal engineering policy — banned deps, required security docs, secret-path forbids. Same schema as CRA/medtech packs; not essential-requirements conformity; not a certification.

rules.description: SECURITY.md missing, too short, or lacking required header.
rules.remediation: Add SECURITY.md with vulnerability reporting and response expectations.
rules.expected: SECURITY.md present with Security header and substantive content.

rules.remediation: Create .well-known/security.txt with Contact and Expires fields.

rules.description: House policy bans vulnerable axios@1.6.0 pins in package.json.
rules.remediation: Upgrade axios to a patched release and refresh the lockfile.
rules.expected: No banned axios versions in dependencies or devDependencies.

rules.description: Likely secrets or private key material found in tracked policy docs.
rules.remediation: Remove credentials from docs; rotate any exposed secrets; use a secret manager.
rules.expected: No secret-like patterns in house policy document paths.

rules.description: House policy docs contain placeholder / boilerplate text.
rules.remediation: Replace TODO / lorem ipsum / [insert ...] with real contact and process details.
rules.expected: No placeholder patterns in required security docs.
